Job Description

What is the opportunity?

At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.

As Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

What will you do?

Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI-first organization.
Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API-first, event-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real-time decision-making, and agile business capability delivery.
Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end-to-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
Build and lead high-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.
Deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and scaling AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
Expert-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Proficiency with both legacy and modern data technologies. Strong foundation in data governance, quality, integration, and analytics.
Integration platform and modernization expertise: Experience leading the transformation of legacy integration infrastructure to modern architectures. Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven systems, and hybrid technology ecosystems
Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C-level.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
Hands-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).
Experience in leading AI adoption and scaling development practices. Established and/or Chaired AI Centers of Excellence that drove organizational AI adoption.
Experience leading successful data modernization programs on multi-platform hybrid environments in large enterprises.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Important Location Requirement:

This is a remote position; however, candidates must be located in the same country, city, or region where the job is posted. The successful candidate must be available to attend a local office, meeting, training session, or company event if requested.

Please only apply if you are based in the location listed on this job posting. Remote does not mean the position is open worldwide.

The Opportunity

Rothenbury Group owns and operates technology-enabled businesses across real estate, property management, brokerage, leasing, maintenance, staffing, media, and other service industries.

The group includes multiple related legal entities with separate accounting records and bank accounts, shared expenses and intercompany transactions, and certain businesses that hold client, trust, or restricted funds.

We are hiring a Vice President of Finance to lead the finance function and provide the CEO with reliable visibility into cash, profitability, obligations, risks, and company performance.

This is a hands-on executive role. You will lead the finance team, strengthen reporting and controls, improve financial operations, and advise leadership on major business decisions.

What You’ll Own

Lead bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, collections, trust accounting, treasury, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
Establish accountability, approval authority, and measurable standards across the finance team.
Produce accurate reporting for each company and the overall group.
Improve monthly closes, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and shared-cost allocations.
Maintain reliable visibility into unrestricted, restricted, and trust cash.
Develop and maintain a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast.
Protect payroll, tax, supplier, and other critical payment obligations.
Lead annual budgets, rolling forecasts, scenario analysis, and financial modelling.
Evaluate company-level revenue, margins, costs, cash requirements, and profitability.
Advise the CEO on hiring, pricing, investments, expansion, and capital allocation.
Strengthen payment approvals, vendor verification, access controls, audit trails, and segregation of duties.
Reduce duplicate payments, unsupported entries, unauthorized changes, and spreadsheet dependency.
Coordinate year-end, tax, audit, banking, legal, and financing matters with external professionals.
Provide concise weekly and monthly executive reporting identifying results, risks, trends, and decisions required.
Improve financial systems, workflows, documentation, and departmental accountability.

First 90 Days

You Will Be Expected To

Assess the finance team, systems, records, controls, and current close status.
Establish a reliable view of cash, trust balances, receivables, payables, payroll, taxes, and upcoming obligations.
Identify material financial, reporting, control, and compliance risks.
Clarify ownership and approval authority across the finance function.
Improve the monthly close and intercompany-reconciliation process.
Introduce practical executive reporting.
Present a prioritized finance-improvement plan with owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

Required Experience

At least 10 years of progressive finance, accounting, controllership, FP&A, or corporate-finance experience.
At least five years in a senior finance leadership position.
Experience leading employees across several accounting or finance functions.
Experience overseeing finance across multiple companies, entities, business units, or operating divisions.
Strong knowledge of intercompany accounting, shared-cost allocation, entity-level reporting, and group-level financial reporting.
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cash management, financial modelling, and working-capital management.
Experience improving monthly closes, reconciliations, controls, systems, and reporting reliability.
Experience working with external accountants, tax advisors, lawyers, lenders, banks, and other professional advisors.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with accounting and financial-reporting systems.
Strong executive communication, judgment, discretion, and accountability.
Confidence challenging unsupported assumptions and advising against decisions when the financial evidence does not support them.

A bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, economics, or a related discipline is required.

A CPA, CA, CMA, CGA, MBA, or comparable senior finance qualification is strongly preferred. Exceptional candidates with equivalent senior operating experience may also be considered.

Experience with real estate, property management, trust or restricted funds, founder-led companies, technology-enabled services, or finance transformation is an asset.

What Success Looks Like

Performance will be measured through:

Reliable entity-level and group-level reporting
Timely monthly closes and reconciliations
Accurate intercompany balances and shared-cost allocations
Clear cash and trust-fund visibility
Improved forecasting and working-capital management
Stronger controls and reduced financial risk
Better finance-team performance and accountability
Clear, decision-ready reporting for the CEO
A finance function capable of supporting continued growth

Who Will Succeed

The right person combines the judgment of a financial executive with the discipline of an experienced finance operator.

You must be comfortable managing people, challenging incomplete explanations, investigating unreliable information, and making difficult recommendations. You should know when to delegate, when to verify the work personally, and when a financial or control issue requires immediate intervention.

This role will not suit someone who relies entirely on verbal updates, avoids difficult performance conversations, accepts unexplained balances, or produces reports without improving the underlying operation.

How To Apply

Apply with your résumé and a brief summary of your senior finance leadership experience.

Candidates whose backgrounds align will receive an email within 24–48 hours with a link to complete a short prerecorded online interview.

Selected candidates will be invited to a live interview and may be required to complete executive reference, education, designation, and background verification.

Mentor and coach staff formally and informally through collaborative teamwork. You embody a “Member-centric” approach while ensuring a high standard of employee engagement, business results and community engagement ensuring execution with excellence.

Ensure that Member continues to be aware of the benefits of using these products, as well as new products available to them. Continuously update knowledge on new products that may be of value to Members
Structure, negotiate and document complex credit and cash management arrangements with segment Members and prospects – often in partnership with Commercial Credit. Negotiate all terms of credit with Commercial Credit and appropriately assess risk in the relationship
Demonstrate a strong working knowledge and excellent analytical skills in the areas of balance sheets, cash flow mechanics, and business plans presented by Members

Minimum 7-10+ years progressive experience in sales/service and managing a diverse portfolio in a commercial banking environment

Ability to work independently with confidence and strong commitment to Member service
Leadership, organizational, impact, influencing and presentation skills
Ability to interact at any level within the organization and in a business development capacity within the community
Advanced credit and interviewing techniques, credit investigation and underwriting skills

Proactive - Seize the initiative by anticipating needs and identifying opportunities to provide a higher level of service.

We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!
We provide you with the tools and technology needed to delight your candidates and clients!
You'll get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders, who have hailed from top organizations around the world
Hybrid work arrangements with in-person office time to collaborate, innovate and build relationships with your colleagues
This isn't your typical "corporate" job. We work hard and we have fun!

, community impact
, and future-readiness

Embedding & leveraging technology – Confidence and willingness to learn and integrate AI and emerging technologies into new ways of working. Experience with low/no code tools like the Microsoft Power Platform and generative AI productivity tools like Microsoft Copilot is considered an asset
Critical Thinking – The ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret information from various sources and apply logic and problem solving to make decisions.

Leading Self

Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, positioning Lifemark as a preferred choice for top clinical talent and possible new acquisitions.
Ensure compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements to uphold Lifemark's esteemed reputation.
Efficiently manage operational budgets, optimizing resource allocation to achieve operational and financial targets and accountable to the results of their area.
Drive Lifemark’s key KPIs and accountable to the results of their area.
